correctness.rationale: Every unital endomorphism sends nilpotent generators into the maximal ideal. Target branches decouple; for d=4 pairwise product constraints become a_i a_j=0 and a_i b_j+b_i a_j=0. Their full zero locus is exactly L0 union L1..Ln. The maximal pairwise-noncontained linear loci yield all components and dimensions after n-fold products. Their disjoint finite-field point counts give all formulas. The argument handles all characteristics, including characteristic 2; direct independent finite-field computations over 13 row cases, 3 exhaustive full cases and 5 samples agree.

value.rationale: The full unital endomorphism monoid and its reduced geometric components are canonical invariants and are strictly richer than the known unit group. The theorem identifies the first appearance of non-equidimensionality in the natural truncation hierarchy, counts exponentially many components with exact dimension multiplicities and computes the uniform finite-field census. The positive unit-density boundary at n=2 versus vanishing at n>=3 reflects the same structural geometry, rather than an unmotivated numerical slice.
